 Vision of the College
      Along with academic pursuits, the vision of our college is to play a catalytic role in
shaping the future of young women by empowering them in all aspects. We envisage to make
them self-reliant, socially responsible and thus enabling them to be the contributors to the
welfare of the nation.

Mission of the College
      The mission of our institution is to provide the best of knowledge and skills to the
students for their personal and professional growth. To realise this, Sibsagar Girls’ College
always seeks to:

❏     Instil in the students a thirst for knowledge, a scientiﬁc temperament and the
      appreciation and inculcation of human values.
❏     To foster all-round development of students through well-deﬁned and multi-faceted
      education.
❏     To facilitate an innovative and conducive learning environment in the campus for the
      students.
❏     To help the students build meaningful careers by strengthening their employability
      skills to make them future-ready.
❏     To make the students equipped with 21st century skills, such as critical thinking,
      problem solving, collaboration, leadership and communication skills.

 The SGC campus is spread over three locations within the radius of two kilometers in aerial distance. Its
total area is 5.28 acres. The main campus is located at the heart of the Sivasagar town. The vicinal
location of historic Siva doul along with Devi doul and Bishnu doul, the age old mosque, the Baptist
Church, the Buddha Bihar beside the scenic Sivasagar Tank has lent a secular environment to the area –
in consonance with our commitment towards diversity, equality and inclusion. The Sibsagar Girls’ College
is centrally located and the District Commissioner's oﬃce, Head Post Oﬃce, Municipality Oﬃce, District
Court, Telecom Oﬃce, Bus Terminal, Railway Station, Tai Museum, Tourist Lodge, Ananda Ram Baruah
Park, Central Market, Wood's Dispensary, Restaurants, Banks and ATMs etc. can be easily accessed from
the college campus.
              INTRODUCING THE THREE CAMPUSES OF THE COLLEGE:
Main Campus
Its geographical location is 260-59' 17.2"N and 940 38' 8" E . The main administrative building (Principal's
Oﬃce, Accounts section, Admission and Examination section), Teacher's Common Room, all Arts
Departments and separate departmental Class Rooms, Auditorium, Conference Hall, Air conditioned virtual
classroom, IGNOU, KKHSOU and Distance Education Study centre, Central Library, Montessori Teachers
Training centre, Apparel Designing centre, Computer Lab, Canteen, Centre for Remote Sensing and GIS
(Under Dept. of Geography) are located in this campus. Most of the classes of Humanities and Social
Sciences along with DIstance Education are held in this campus.
Science Campus
It is just about 100 metres away from the main campus. All classes of Science Stream, Community Science
as well as Sociology (major)and Sanskriti Play School are held in the campus. The campus houses all
science Departments including the Community science Department, Sanskriti Play School, Biotech hub,
Rangpur Chatri Nivas. Indoor Stadium with Gymnasium, Sanskriti Badminton Academy, Aryabhatta Science
centre, Botanical Garden, Canteen and a two storeyed Laboratory building. The newly introduced
Psychology Department will be housed in this campus.
Baniabari Campus
It is about 2 kms. away from the main campus and well connected with the other two campuses. Alongwith
Sanskriti Computer Centre, different extended activities such as— Banana orchard, Fisheries and Vegetable
orchard are in this campus. There is ambitious plans to convert this campus into a skill hub and incubation
centre in near future.

PROJECT “SAKHI- A RAY OF HOPE”

An initiative taken by District Administration in collaboration with ONGC. Sibsagar Girls’ College is
a privileged beneﬁciary of this project under which a Sanitary Napkin disposal system comprising
of vending machine and incinerator have been installed in the college premises.
 CENTRAL LIBRARY & INFORMATION CENTRE
As book is the lung of a body of knowledge so is the library in case of a college. We can boast of the Central Library
and Information Centre of SGC which houses thousands of books, journals, references. e-books, e-journals,
reprographic facilities, air conditioned reading hall, book bank for economically poor students, internet cafe,
INFLIBNET N-list, Automated circulation, DIR and OPAC system etc. Once you get in the library you will be oriented by
the amiable library staff on how to use and receive best services of the library. Spacious reading room with 120+
seating capacity at a time with the quiet and peaceful environment motivates you to sink in the world of knowledge
and information. Automated Library Networking System makes it easier in handling the library. Photograph
collections of the library drive you to the history and antiquity of the state at large.
       Besides, each department of Sibsagar Girls’ College has rich collection of books and reference materials in
the form of Departmental Library where students can fulﬁl their emergent requirements.

                  Library Collections : Books-50800, Journals-15, Magazine-15 News Paper-12,
          E-resources More than 32000 (Library timing : Opening hour 9.00 A.M. Closing hour 4.00 P.M. )
INTERNET SECTION & DIGITAL REPOSITORY
Air conditioned internet lab capable of accommodating 30 students at one go serves the SGCians' everyday
academic life. Downloading of data and printing thereof is normally done at a very cheaper rate. BSNL Broadband
connection with 80 MBPS speed fulﬁls learner's assigned works and connects them in the world wide web. An well
equipped Digital Resource Access Point and Digital Repository has been setup in Central Library where rare
manuscripts. college magazines, question papers etc. are digitally archived with user-friendly software.




MODERN LEARNING RESOURCES
SGC is no longer lagging behind the modern tools in Teaching and Learning process. Keeping view of the ongoing
revolution in the system at Global scenario, SGC has already installed and procured Modern Learning resources. LCD
projectors, Interactive white Board. Digital Classroom. Virtual Classroom, Audio System, Intemet Lab, OPAC. N-list
e-journal access, Mapping and Statistical Software, Matlab, Biotech Hub, Modern Laboratory Equipments at basic
Science Department are a few to mention.

COMPUTER LAB & MEDIA CENTRE
A well equipped computer laboratory with 60 computers has been setup for enhancements of computer skills of
students. Media centre is actively engaged in Media Broadcasting and E-Content Development for Students.

SGC always gears up the hidden energy and talents of

towards the service of the nation. 11th Assam Girls'
Cadet Corps trains up the SGCians through NCC

Apart from NCC, SGC also carries out Social Services in

Service Scheme (NSS) programme under Dibrugarh

      Both NCC and NSS discharge the much needed
corporate social responsibility of the college. So what
are you waiting for? Join today in NSS and NCC at SGC
and become a responsible citizen.
 Sibsagar Girls' College always looks into the
psychomotor development of the students. The college
provides state-of-the-art facilities to the sports of all
categories. It has already built up a spacious Indoor
Stadium with Gymnasium to facilitate Badminton, Table

SGC has been untiring through the ages giving best
effort to pick up talents in art and music. Be it the

of the Dibrugarh University, the SGCian girls create
sensation and transcends the art and music to an
another world. The 'HUSORI' team of SCC, you will ﬁnd,
has become the brand in SCC's musical arena. Another
reason the SGC takes pride is the continuous hegemony
over debating championships in the Upper Assam
region over the years. Really SGCians have been making
waves in the arena of wit and wisdom, as well as
performing arts.


A spacious and healthy common room plays vital role in
making students more social and relaxed. You can be
more disciplined in the SCC's common room where
minor indoor games, oﬃce of the students’ union and
public utility services awaits at your disposal. Running
water, Puriﬁed drinking water and sterilised lavatories
make the SCC's common room more vibrant and
comfortable. The seating area is under the surveillance
with close circuit cameras for your safety and security.



Being SGCian you need to develop social responsibility
within the campus along with the co-curricular and
ﬁnally extend it towards the positive change in the
community, apart from your regular activity within the
gamut of teaching learning system. The college and the
community want your presence and cooperation in the
community development missions like plantation of
trees, awareness and solid waste disposal and pollution
control initiatives, citizens’ voting right, observance of
Girl Child Protection, Unity and Integration mission,
Communal harmony mission, sustainable rural
development mission, blood donation campaign and
what not.
                                                  Four Year Undergraduate Programmes

(i) UG Certiﬁcate Programme: UG Certiﬁcate Programme leads to a UG certiﬁcate after completing 1 year
(2 semesters) of study in the chosen ﬁelds of study. Students on exit shall be awarded UG certiﬁcate (in
the Field of Study/Discipline) after securing the requisite 44 Credits on completion of Semester II if, in
addition, they complete one work based/skill based vocational course/internship of 4 credits within one
year from the completion of 2nd semester examination. These students are allowed to re-enter the degree
programme within a period of three years and complete the degree within the stipulated maximum period
of seven years.
(ii) UG Diploma Programme: UG Diploma Programme leads to a UG diploma after 2 years (4 semesters)
of study in the chosen ﬁelds of study. Students on exit shall be awarded UG Diploma (in the Field of
Study/Discipline) after securing the requisite 88 Credits on completion of Semester IV if, in addition, they
complete one work based/skill based vocational course/internship of 4 credits within one year from the
completion of 4th semester examination. These students are allowed to re-enter the degree programme
within a period of three years and complete the degree within the maximum period of seven years.
(iii) Three Year UG Degree Programme with single/double major: Students who wish to undergo a 3-year
(6 semester) UG programme shall be awarded UG degree in the Major discipline after successful
completion of three years, securing a minimum of 132 credits. Provision of double Major shall be
implemented in due course of time.
(iv) Four Year UG Programme with honours with single/double major: Students who wish to undergo a
4-year (8 semester) UG programme shall be awarded UG Honours degree in the Major discipline after
successful completion of four years, securing a minimum of 176 credits. Provision of double Major shall
be implemented in due course of time.
(v) Four Year UG Programme with honours with Research with single/double major: Students who wish
to undergo a 4-year (8 semester) UG programme shall be awarded UG Honours and research degree in the
Major discipline after successful completion of four years with a rigorous research project, securing a
minimum of 176 credits. Option for double Major shall be offered in due course of time.

 DISCIPLINE (Rules & Regulations)
SGC promulgates stringent guidelines to make the students community more disciplined in order to mould them in
accordance with the institution's own philosophy. Having been coined an identity in the greater sivasagar district and in
the upper Assam region through the ages the SGC has been producing quality students year after year.
At SGC campus.
 ❏ You are highly expected to come with proper Uniform, Badge and Posture.
 ❏ No mobile phones are allowed in the campuses.
 ❏ Instill peace and harmony.
 ❏ Any acts leading to defamation of the college are strictly banned.
 ❏ Any misconducts/misbehaviour in the examination hall during examination subject to punishment according to
       the University rules and regulations.
 ❏ Respect college employees of all categories and cooperate them.
 ❏ Protect the campus resources.
 ❏ Do not shunt in the nearby Market complex or anywhere outside the campus during the class hours.
 ❏ Through and dump garbages at proper sites.
 ❏ Make the campuses pollution and tobacco free zone.
Uniform
 ❏ White blouse, Muga coloured mekhela and white chadar with deep green border or white salwar with dark green
       dupatta and white kameez with side openings bordered by green pipings.
 ❏ It is obligatory for every student to wear college uniform including the College badge and to keep in possession
       the Identity Card issued by the College authority during college hours and also while attending functions in the
       College campus or outside representing the college.
 ❏ The college authority will supply the college badge and duly endorsed Identity Cards after admission.
Anti Ragging (Link available on UGC portal)
 ❏ SGC campus is a Ragging free zone.
 ❏ The authority constituted an Anti Ragging Squad with all necessary mechanisms in accordance with the UGC's
       guidelines and Assam Govt.'s Rule. Violation of the rule leads to severe punishment otherwise.
 ❏ You can feel free in the process of assimilation in your college days at SGC.
 ❏ In case you need to report, use following number - Oﬃce of the Principal (03772-232778)
Sexual Harassment Prevention
 ❏ SGC is quite keen to monitor the cases of sexual harassment/abuse, if any, of both students and staff members.
 ❏ The concerned cell, through proper channel, redresses the cases and makes proper decisions for further
       prevention according to legal provisions.
Discipline at SGC Hostel
        The Rangpur Chatri Niwas also underlays guidelines for the boarders to keep learning and aesthetic
environment remain intact in the campus.Maintain different time schedule of the hostel

 ❏ Abide by the commands of both Hostel Warden and Matron.
 ❏ Instill integration, peace and harmony.
 ❏ Any act vulnerable to deteriorating the normalcy of hostel environment are strictly banned .
 ❏ Make hostel pollution and tobacco free zone.
 ❏ Respect hostel staff and cooperate them.
 ❏ Address your grievances either at hostel or at college authority.
 ❏ Keep your surrounding clean.
Attendance
       A student who has less than 80% attendance in average shall not be permitted to sit for the End-semester
       examination. As per University regulation a student declared as dis-collegiate shall not be allowed to proceed to
       the next higher Semester

INTERNAL ASSESSMENT AND EVALUATION SYSTEM
Continuous Evaluation of the Students are done on the basis of the following parameters

      (i) Class Attendance, attendance in sessional lists
      (ii) Use of Library services by the students.
      (iii) Participations in Seminar/Group discussion etc.
      (iv) Performance in the Home Assignments
      (v) Participation in Club Activities.
Students has to fulﬁll these requirements to secure a satisfactory grade in their Internal
Assessment.

EXAMINATION AND EXAMINATION RULES
      Sessional Examinations for undergraduate students are to be held as per the Academic
Calendar.

      Students must appear in all of these examinations and secure a minimum qualifying
mark in each subject. Failure to fulﬁll this condition will not be allowed to appear in Final
Examination.

ACADEMIC CALENDAR
        For systematic organisation and strict implementation of academic and co-curricular
activities, the College prepares an academic calendar in accordance with the Dibrugarh
University Academic Calendar . Student can access the same from college website.
 Students Association

The Sibsagar Girls’ College Students Union (SGCSU) is the General Body of the College. The membership of
SGCSU is compulsory for all students. Portfolios of SGCSU are elected annually by all students as per the
constitution of SGCSU. All of them have to work under the guidance of Prof. in charge(s) of the respective
portfolios of SGCSU.

Alumnae Association
The Alumnae Association of SGC is a pride stakeholder of the institution. They are the integral part of the college.
